question: What degradation rates of 2-CEES did FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs reach after 3 h and after 6 h?
rendered:
Document 1: "3D network carbon nanotube film supported FeCoNiCrMn high-entropy alloy nanoparticles for integrated adsorption and detoxification of sulfur mustard simulant"

According to page 6, the degradation rate of 2-CEES by FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs was:

* 9.3% after 1.5 h
* 39.3% after 3 h
* 93.1% after 6 h

So, the degradation rates after 3 h and after 6 h are 39.3% and 93.1%, respectively.
